name: PPB
recent: PPB Group 在2026年11月25日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，因Wilmar贡献增强而转亏为盈，但核心利润下滑。公司近期持续进行股份回购，雇员公积金局（EPF）多次申报股权变动，一名董事在公开市场增持股份。
notable: 公司公布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩，转亏为盈。
公司近期多次进行股份回购。
一名董事于2026年10月22日在公开市场增持10,000股普通股。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在2026年9月至11月期间多次申报股权变动。
董事在公开市场进行股份交易。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为13.18亿令吉，环比增长2.6%，同比下滑3.0%；净利为3.38亿令吉，环比增长44.5%，同比增长20.8%，净利率为25.6%。

recent_en: PPB Group announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September on 25 November 2026, swinging to profit on stronger Wilmar contribution, though core profit declined. The company has been conducting share buybacks, the Employees Provident Fund Board has made multiple substantial shareholder filings, and a director acquired shares in the open market.
notable_en: The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, swinging to profit.
The company conducted multiple share buybacks recently.
A director acquired 10,000 ordinary shares in the open market on 22 October 2026.
risks_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board made multiple substantial shareholder filings between September and November 2026.
A director conducted share dealings in the open market.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1,318.4 million, up 2.6% QoQ and down 3.0% YoY; net income was RM338.1 million, up 44.5% QoQ and 20.8% YoY, with a net margin of 25.6%.
